title: A Noetherian filtered colimit of etale algebras has finite separable fibres
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $B=\varinjlim_{i\in J}B_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] be a filtered colimit of etale $A$-algebras [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Assume $B$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. For every prime $\mathfrak p\subset A$, there are finitely many primes $\mathfrak q_1,\ldots,\mathfrak q_r\subset B$ over $\mathfrak p$ and a canonical product decomposition $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\prod_{j=1}^r\kappa(\mathfrak q_j)$, where $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ and $\kappa(\mathfrak q_j)$ are residue fields [def-weil-residue-field], and each extension $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\subset\kappa(\mathfrak q_j)$ is separable algebraic.
